title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 2: Miki Uchiyama
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ Ｖｏｌ．２ ～内山美紀～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 2: Uchiyama Miki is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Miki Uchiyama. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame. Winning three rounds of the minigame will unlock a bonus video.
